name: Ancestor’s Vessel (Totemist Archetype)
body:
Totemists hold their ancestors close to their hearts. Some, like the ancestor’s vessel, either bind the spirit of their ancestor to themselves, or are possessed by an ancestor seeking resolution in a world from which they were taken too soon.

Ancestor Spirit (Su)

Ancestor’s vessels can draw on their resonance to call forth a physical manifestation of the ancestor within them.

This ability functions as the spiritualist’s phantom class feature, except the ancestor’s vessel’s phantom deals damage as a Small creature unless the ancestor’s vessel uses a swift action to strengthen its resonance within reality for the turn. The ancestor’s vessel also gains etheric tether, but is unable to grant hit points to their ancestor using that ability.

This ability replaces nature’s bond and the resonance effects gained at 3rd, 7th, 11th, 15th, and 19th level.

Ancestor’s Resonance (Su)

In addition to the resonance effects any totemist can select, an ancestor’s vessel can choose from the following resonance effects.

Ancestor’s Consciousness Visual

Your face contorts and takes on a striking resemblance to your ancestor. As you cast the spell, you can also spend 1 resonance to gain the Skill Focus feat in two skills determined by your ancestor’s emotional focus while you maintain the resonance, up to 1 minute.

If you spend 2 additional resonance, you also gain a +4 bonus on saving throws against all mind-affecting effects while you maintain the resonance, up to 1 minute.

Ancestor’s Protection Audible

You and your ancestor speak as one, intoning each other perfectly even at a distance. This functions as the spiritualist’s spiritual interference while you maintain the resonance, up to 1 minute.

If you select this resonance again at 13th-level or higher, it functions as greater spiritual interference, instead.

Ancestor’s Recall Audible

With a shout, you grab the attention of your ancestor, who either returns to you or fades back into your resonance. This functions as the spiritualist’s phantom recall. It costs 1 resonance the first time you use it each day, and 2 resonance each time after.

Ancestor’s Tether Visual

The resonance connecting you to your ancestor shines briefly as you give your own lifeforce to keep them around. As you cast the spell, you can also spend 1 resonance plus any number of hit points to heal your ancestor for an equal amount.
